Lina (PM): kicking off PRD intake for a 'behavioral contracts' feature — customers want per-tenant guarantees and automatic rollback on quality regressions. need problem statement, goals, non-goals, and measurable success metrics. :eyes:
Samir (eng): quick q — is this for Hosted only or also Dedicated/Private?
Lina (PM): target all deployment modes but start Hosted + Dedicated. Private will be opt-in (privacy concerns).
Jin Park: problem statement suggestion: high-value customers require deterministic behavior across model upgrades/quantization; current rollouts risk silent regressions in NLU intents.
Anya Patel: add non-goal: we won't try to fix model-level hallucination via this feature (that's model ops). this is detection + automated rollback routing.
Mike Chen: acceptable success metrics draft: 1) detection precision >= 95% on curated evals, 2) rollback decision latency < 5m from detection, 3) end-user error rate delta <= +2% post-rollout, 4) cost delta <= 10% for protected tenants.
Samir (eng): implementation ask: need canary runner that executes representative prompt set per-tenant + statistical test. propose: sequential A/B with binomial test (alpha=0.01) on pass/fail per prompt.
Jin Park: edge cases to call out: small tenants with <1000 monthly calls — stats are noisy; also bursty workloads where KV cache changes affect perf.
Anya Patel: non-goal: we won't provide legal SLA wording. PM/Legal will handle that separately.
Mike Chen: acceptance criteria (engineering): 1) infra supports per-tenant canaries, 2) policy engine can trigger model variant swap in <30s, 3) observability exposes per-tenant eval history + diff graph.
Lina (PM): rollout phases: alpha with internal customers (>=3 tenants), beta with willing power users, GA when metrics stable 2 weeks.
qa-bot: automated note — added checklist: "eval harness + per-tenant config UI + rollback webhook" to product/roadmap board.
Samir (eng): next steps: I'll sketch RFC for the canary runner and stats approach by EOD Thursday. Jin and Mike — can you two draft the core prompt sets and pass/fail rubric?
Lina (PM): thanks — I'll compile goals/non-goals into PRD template and include the metrics above. ping here when drafts ready. :thumbsup:
